faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Quick answers on YouTube chapter creation, privacy, and supported video formats.
faq.q1: How do I format YouTube video chapters so they work in the description?
faq.a1: Start your first chapter at 00:00 (or 00:00:00), include at least 3 timestamps in ascending order, and keep each chapter at least 10 seconds long. YouTube Video Chapter Marker lets you choose your preferred format (0:00, 00:00, 00:00:00, or dash-separated) and exports ready-to-paste lines for your YouTube description.
faq.q2: Are my local video files uploaded to a server?
faq.a2: No. Local video files (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, M4V) are analyzed and played entirely inside your browser. Your media files never leave your device.
faq.q3: Can I edit existing chapters from a published YouTube video?
faq.a3: Yes. Paste any public YouTube URL or 11-character video ID to load playback and automatically extract existing description chapters in read-only mode, then refine timestamps or titles and copy the updated list.
faq.q4: What makes frame-accurate VFR seeking useful for chapter marking?
faq.a4: Screen recordings and smartphone clips often use Variable Frame Rate (VFR). By building a frame correspondence map, you can step frame-by-frame or second-by-second with J/K/L and arrow keys and snap markers to exact scene transitions.
faq.q5: Is YouTube Video Chapter Marker free to use without creating an account?
faq.a5: Yes. It is completely free, requires no registration or installation, and runs directly in modern desktop browsers with a multilingual interface.
